posts.summary_en: CrumbleHub's deck-sharing database has a guild_raid mode; it held 11 shared decks on 2026-09-27 (one titled '1G dmg at 69M Power'). Records carry 12 cookies, 3 pets, captain slot and mercenary-band perks but no levels/stars/runes. Appearance count across decks: 브시커 11, 석류 11, 우유 11, 전갈 11, 마카롱 11, 닼초 10, 피노 10, 피겨 9, 허브 9, 호밀 9, 실론 9, 메소 5, 딸크 4, 정전 4, 치케 3, 밀키 1, 딸기쇼트케이크 1, 포도넝쿨 1, 마들렌 1, 바람궁수 1. Pets are near-uniform: 갓난갓방울 in every deck, 판다만두 in most, plus 핫도그도그 or 전지멜로우.

posts.summary_en: Curated meta-deck list has a '길드 토벌전' category in the UI code, but on 2026-09-27 the API returned only stage, implant_tower and arena decks — no curated Guild Conquest deck yet.

Unofficial formula sheet: crit rate over 100% rolls into a higher crit tier, element advantage is +15% plus element-damage bonus, skill haste works as base x 100/(100+haste), under-power penalty hits outgoing damage only, DR stacks multiplicatively.
mechanics: 치명확률 above 100% is not wasted: 150% = guaranteed crit + 50% chance of a one-tier-stronger crit; effective crit tiers = (crit rate − target crit res) ÷ 100.
Element advantage: Fire>Grass, Water>Fire, Grass>Water, Light<->Dark. Advantage multiplier = 1 + 15% + element-damage bonus; element-damage bonus does nothing without advantage.
Skill haste: effective cooldown = base cooldown × 100 ÷ (100 + haste); haste 50 → 66.67% cooldown, haste 100 → 50%.
Below recommended power, outgoing damage is penalised; healing and damage taken are not.
Final ATK = floor(base ATK × (1 + % bonuses) + flat bonuses); companion-pet conditional passives are applied separately, so the stat screen ATK can hide them.
Defense multiplier = 1 ÷ (1 + ln(1 + DEF ÷ 500)); DEF 500 → ~59.05% damage taken.
DMG reduction stacks multiplicatively: A + B − A×B (two 20% → 36%).
Debuff application ≈ base rate × focus ÷ target resist (cap 100%); some status effects ignore resist.
disagreements: Defense formula differs from alkapa: crumblehub 1/(1+ln(1+DEF/500)) vs alkapa effective HP = HP × (1 + DEF/500).

quotes.en: Applied cooldown = base cooldown × 100 ÷ (100 + skill haste)

quotes.kr: 유리 상성 피해 배율 = 1 + 15% + 속성 피해 증가
quotes.en: Advantage damage multiplier = 1 + 15% + element damage bonus

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런: 크럼블 가이드 — 알아두면 좋은 전투 원리 (KAPA LAB, 게임 1.3.002 기준)
posts.summary_en: Combat-rule explainer written against game 1.3.002: crit multiplier 1 + crit rate × crit dmg with no 100% cap, element bonus exclusive with target element defense, haste diminishing, PvE crit res saturates at 10%, DR has no diminishing returns, accuracy/focus saturate at 100% hit/apply.
mechanics: Crit multiplier = 1 + crit rate × crit dmg, no 100% cap on crit rate.
If the target has the matching element defense, your element-damage bonus is not applied (only their reduction); bonuses and reductions never sum.
Skill haste sits in the cooldown denominator → diminishing returns.
PvE crit res saturates at 10% (most monsters have 10% crit rate).
Effective survivability ∝ 1 ÷ (1 − DR): no diminishing returns; effective HP = HP × (1 + DEF ÷ 500).
Accuracy saturates at 100% hit rate; focus saturates at 100% debuff application.
disagreements: Crit >100%: alkapa models it as linear (1 + rate × dmg); crumblehub describes discrete crit tiers. Same expected value, different variance model.
Defense formula conflicts with crumblehub (see crumblehub-guides-stats).

quotes.kr: 치명 배수는 1 + 치명확률 × 치명피해로 계산되며, 치명확률에는 100% 상한이 적용되지 않습니다.
quotes.en: Crit multiplier is 1 + crit rate × crit damage; crit rate has no 100% cap.

posts.summary_en: Session-cookie-gated JSON API exposing datamined client data (1.4.002, generated 2026-09-23): all 76 cookies and 57 pets with ko/en names, per-star skill coefficients, buff/debuff raw values and cooldowns, gear plates with main/sub option pools, and sugar-rune roll pools with weights. Values are raw game integers; units are inferred (buff rawValue 6900 on a percent stat likely = 69%). The site's own community deck list (/api/decks) has no raid decks.

sugar_runes.stats: Sugar-rune slots unlock at stars 0/2/4/6/8/8/10/10. SSR roll values: ATK%/DEF%/HP% 6.1/6.5/7.0 (weights 6/3/1); CRIT%/CRIT RES/CRIT DMG 7.0/7.4/8.0; Accuracy/Evasion/Focus/Resist rate 5.2/5.6/6.0; Skill AMP 4.4/4.7/5.0; DMG Reduction 5.3/5.7/6.0 (raw ÷100, weights 6/3/1). Skill Haste SSR line = 4 or 5 flat (raw 40000/50000 ÷1e4, weights 8/2), so 8 SSR slots give at most 40 haste from runes alone.

다크초코 Dark Choco: cooldown 6 s, DEF reduction basePercent 20, maxStack 10.
피노누아 Pinot Noir: ally buff every 9.5 s gives Lift resistance + Rapid Fire synergy (skill-repeat count up); bullets every 3.25 s cut enemy healing 80%.

posts.summary_en: Synergy-maximising team finder with content modes 방치/PVP/보스; no Guild Conquest mode, no rune or gear advice. States that duplicate synergies and duplicate debuffs do not stack (only the strongest applies).
mechanics: Same synergy from two givers does not stack; only the stronger applies. Same for debuffs (two DEF-reduction cookies → only the larger).

quotes.kr: 같은 종류의 시너지가 겹치면 더 센 것 하나만 적용됩니다.
quotes.en: When the same synergy overlaps, only the stronger one applies.
